The report's own rule ('where the original text below conflicts with this section, this section governs') covers both; no number is affected.

proposed_validation_json_rho_reference.protocol: PLAN s2/s4 and ANALYSIS_PLAN s9 name rho-neg (rho.negation) as the matched rho, paired with ic on the same (workload, target, round), and rho-cubic (rho.cubic, the order-6 automorphism fold) on the V5 j = 0 crater (census A3 F1). rho-neg is the strongest available on all 648 V6 vertices and the 63 non-crater V5 vertices (j not in {0, 1728}, prime fields); on the V5 crater (p = 1 and r = 1 mod 3) the strongest is rho-cubic, and the report compares IC with it there (89.3x / 98.2x / 141.2x at 0 / 0.1 / 1 GAE). H-T's denominator is rho-neg at j != 0 sources, the strongest there.
proposed_validation_json_rho_reference.unit: S (ecbench normalised group operations: total_gae / sqrt(r)), the unpriced native operations each arm names (cost.unpriced, from records.jsonl per A2.1) priced at 0 / 0.1 / 1 GAE on both arms
proposed_validation_json_rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench sha256 ac4bc5b26f858a4d8a374208297157840af25fb1dc25ea1c19dd41360735fb35 (runs/progress.jsonl header and every record); every arm, references included, in the same sessions
proposed_validation_json_rho_reference.note: gae_band: V6 pooled mean priced S of ic and rho-neg over (ic, rho-neg) pairs of the isogenous families (the Q1 population). gae_band_by_volcano adds V5 levels 1-6 (rho-neg) and V5crater (ic against rho-cubic, D + N pairs; rho-neg shown for reference). Rho is ahead at every price, every level of both volcanoes and on the crater; the ratio is the distance remaining, not a pass/fail.

limitations: Replay (ecbench verify --replay-all) covers 20 of 147 sessions (seeded stratified sample: all 14 volcano x family strata, the 3 V5 crater rho-cubic sessions, 3 Tcr, 2 M, 2 redone .r2); every session also has its committed Phase B audit (1,764 replays identical) and every record of all 147 archives was re-derived by this validator ([k]G = Q, S, A2.1 uncharged counts, extracts row by row).
The replay used the same shared cloud VM type and the same ecbench binary as the sessions: it re-executes operation counts; it is not an independent solver implementation or independent hardware.

Bootstrap CIs and permutation p-values were recomputed with independent draws: they agree within Monte Carlo error, not bit for bit. Categorical outcomes within about 1-2 Monte Carlo SE of a threshold (H-M V6:98; V6 rho-neg L2 and rho-plain L1 TOST) can differ between draws; the report now says so for H-M.

Not re-run: the s5 paired-source and transport-then-solve bootstraps and signal flags, per-vertex H-T CIs, per-family R(L), the s4 per-curve p-values (only the attainable minimum), the slug-cluster CI is compared informally; the s9 CIs were recomputed with a 2,000-replicate vertex-cluster bootstrap and compared only as 'lower end above 1'; the mixed model was re-run for ic only.
Wall time is descriptive in the study; it was checked only as A/A ratios and L2 fractions.
This validation makes the receipts admissible evidence for the benchmarks row; it does not support an ECDLP claim, a speedup, or promotion.
